description: This file defines the 'ProductImageDescription' class, which extends 'Description' and models descriptive metadata for product images, including a reference to 'ProductImage' and an alt tag. It uses JPA annotations for ORM mapping.

classes.name: ProductImageDescription
classes.description: Entity class representing descriptions for product images, including alt text and a reference to the associated product image.
